name: Engineering Dashboard Master Data Creation
type: AM Platform / Construction dashboard / Notion master data

dataIsolation.guard: Every write uses tenant-locked notionRequest and revalidates the project data source, project scope, space data source, and space-project relation.

definitionOfDone: Every visible engineering project shows create Space, Trade, and Work Item controls
Created Spaces are related to the selected project in the tenant-local Notion data source
Created Trades persist as Work Items data-source select options and are available across that engineering tenant's projects
Created Work Items require project, space, trade, planned start, and planned end and appear in the Gantt and matrix after refresh
Cross-project space relations and out-of-scope project writes are rejected
Syntax, mock Notion write, package, and alignment verification pass
Production Render deployment and live Notion write proof are recorded before status becomes Deployed
